native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Nishang Invoke-PowerShell Reverse Shell
native_rule.s1ql: ((( tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'powershell') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Net.Sockets.TCPClient') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'stream.Read') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '$sendback') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'GetBytes') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '$stream.Write' )) OR (( tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'powershell') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'DownloadString') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Invoke-PowerShellTcp') AND (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase '-Reverse' )))
